bible.title: The Toll of Thornhollow
bible.kernel: A Shallows collector hires the company to fetch a bride whose marriage will end a local feud, but a necromancer binds her to the ruin at Thornhollow.

cast.name: Nuleem-Malem of the Shallows
cast.who: A river-harbor collector from the Shallows who brokers pledges to keep trade moving.
cast.want: to deliver the client-named betrothed to Thornhollow for the betrothal ceremony

cast.name: Wuja-Meenus
cast.who: A lizardman healer from the marsh tribes, pragmatic and blunt.
cast.want: to be free of the feud by marrying

cast.name: Umbelmion
cast.who: A Thornhollow cultist who claims the dead heed his voice.
cast.want: to stop the betrothal and keep Thornhollow's rites under his control

bible.situation: Nuleem-Malem hired the company to fetch the bride and bring her to Thornhollow for a betrothal that will end a feud. Wuja-Meenus is in the Shallows but has been marked by Umbelmion with a necromantic summons that binds her to Thornhollow. Umbelmion intends to use the ruin and its tomb-signs to block the match and preserve his hold on the dead.
bible.goal: to escort the client-named betrothed from Rillshore to Thornhollow and hand her over for the betrothal ceremony
arc: Ride to Rillshore on Nuleem's orders to fetch the client-named betrothed → yields: Wuja-Meenus found hiding in a fisher's loft, bound by an inked summons from Umbelmion.
Use Umbelmion's summons to track rites into the Fallow Mire and force entry at his outpost → yields: a carved bone key cut with the tomb-sign used at Thornhollow.
Take the bone key into the ruin of Thornhollow, break the tomb rites, defeat Umbelmion and his risen wards, and hand Wuja-Meenus over to Nuleem at the ruined altar
tensions: Umbelmion's necromancy binds Wuja-Meenus to the tomb-signs of Thornhollow
Forest kin of the rival family patrol routes and may ambush escorts
Villagers' old fear of the dead will turn aid into suspicion when the company carries a lizardman bride
openDirections: If the betrothal succeeds, Nuleem could bind the company into future levy-pledges or political backing from the Shallows
bible.stakeIfLost: If the betrothal fails, the Shallows' villages will halt the river levies, costing Nuleem his season's toll income and collapsing his harvest disbursements.
bible.arrival: sent word twice before coming · would not sit down

shipped.title: Fetch the betrothed at Rillshore
shipped.situation: A river-harbor collector from the Shallows, Nuleem-Malem of the Shallows, sent word twice before coming and would not sit down. He says if the betrothal fails the Shallows' villages will halt the river levies and Nuleem loses his season's toll income and harvest disbursements. He wants the client-named betrothed fetched at Rillshore and brought to Thornhollow for the betrothal ceremony, the fee is fixed, and what else shakes loose the company keeps. A necromancer intends to stop the betrothal and keep Thornhollow's rites under his control. He keeps turning something over in one palm as he says the Shallows cannot wait.
shipped.job: Ride to Rillshore and fetch the client-named betrothed.
